measurements.fits: prompt tokens (chat template included) + response tokens (to and including the end token) <= 512
measurements.dropped rule (primary, decisions.md 2026: an answer that does not fit leaves the score; a pair leaves when either side does; a template leaves when its GSM8K original does not fit, and keeps only its fitting instances
measurements.capped rule (reported beside): every answer kept, graded on its first 512 - prompt tokens (commute.qwen_eval capped_response)
measurements.D_plus: over GSM8K test problems i where both the GSM8K answer and the GSM-Plus answer fit and the GSM-Plus gold is an integer: mean(strict_gsm8k_i - strict_plus_i), absolute. Paired SE = sqrt(b + c - (b - c)^2 / n) / n, b = GSM8K right and GSM-Plus wrong, c = the reverse. Reported beside it: the same on all answers (decimal golds included), on the lenient grader, and under the capped rule
measurements.D_sym: over templates t whose GSM8K original fits and that have at least one fitting instance: mean over t of (strict_original_t - share of t's fitting instances strict-right), absolute; SE = stdev over templates / sqrt(T). The originals' strict scores come from the same job's GSM8K arm. Reported beside it: lenient, capped, the originals' own accuracy
measurements.gap_x: lenient minus strict accuracy on set x's fitting answers (x = gsm8k, plus, symbolic)
measurements.control: the GSM8K arm's strict accuracy over all its answers (as the baseline scored it), and the share of its responses identical to experiments/qwen_gsm8k_baseline/results/large/greedy.jsonl
